item.title: Version 0.0.1
item.description:
• Dock Peek: hover an app in the Dock to see its windows, styled like the island, with quick controls.
  • Activating a license works on every network: some Indonesian providers blocked the license server's old address.
  • Brightness changes made through BetterDisplay now show on the island, like the volume.
  • Improvements and fixes.
